description: Provision an AWS Codeartifact PackageGroup via the ACK codeartifact controller. Fields mirror the codeartifact.services.k8s.aws/v1alpha1 PackageGroup spec.

contactInfo.description:
The contact information for the created package group.

Regex Pattern: `^\P{C}*$`

description.description:
A description of the package group.

Regex Pattern: `^\P{C}*$`

domain.description:
The name of the domain in which you want to create a package group.

Regex Pattern: `^[a-z][a-z0-9\-]{0,48}[a-z0-9]$`

domainOwner.description:
The 12-digit account number of the Amazon Web Services account that owns
the domain. It does not include dashes or spaces.

Regex Pattern: `^[0-9]{12}$`

pattern.description:
The pattern of the package group to create. The pattern is also the identifier
of the package group.

Regex Pattern: `^[^\p{C}\p{IsWhitespace}]+$`

region.description: AWS region for this resource (e.g. eu-west-1). Rendered as the services.k8s.aws/region annotation. Empty inherits the ACK controller's default region.
region.title: AWS region

tags.description: One or more tag key-value pairs for the package group.

items.description:
A tag is a key-value pair that can be used to manage, search for, or filter
resources in CodeArtifact.

title: AWS Codeartifact PackageGroup
